export function usageQuote(units: number, multiplier: number = configuration.rate, plan?: string) {
  const amount = evaluate(units, multiplier, plan);

evidence.reason: Before edit called metering.initialize() then metering.evaluate(units, 0.1, "monthly"); after edit calls metering.usageCharge(units, 0.1, "benchmark") directly, removing initialize() and changing plan from "monthly" to "benchmark".
Right edit rebinds evaluate from usageCharge to usageChargeV2, but subscriptionCharge no longer references evaluate, so the right edit's effect on subscriptionCharge is bypassed.
usageQuote still calls evaluate, so the right edit changes usageQuote's behavior; tests assert usageQuote(30, 0.1, "monthly").amount > 0, which may be affected by the evaluate rebinding.

Test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 and evaluate(20, 0.1, "monthly") > 0; the left edit's removal of initialize() and plan change could break these assertions if usageCharge requires initialization or treats plan differently.

result.userExplanation: 两处修改合并后，subscriptionCharge 不再经过 evaluate，且去掉了 metering.initialize() 并把 plan 从 "monthly" 改为 "benchmark"，可能改变订阅计费行为，而 usageCharge 与 usageChargeV2 是否等价、initialize 是否必需尚不明确。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/subscription.ts 的 subscriptionCharge 作者确认是否应保留 metering.initialize() 并继续通过 metering.evaluate 调用（或明确 usageCharge 可独立使用且 plan 参数 "benchmark" 是有意变更）；同时请 src/metering.ts 的 evaluate 作者确认 usageChargeV2 与 usageCharge 的兼容性。
